answer.rationale: Primary region write latency spike 90 minutes post-release during peak settlement traffic is highest-probability indicator of release regression. Memory_b1 shows rollback cleared checkout errors without customer impact; memory_b2 confirms regional failover effectiveness if needed as fallback. Memory_b6 validates that staged release gating catches regressions early, supporting assumption that this release likely contains the degradation. Rolling back removes the suspected cause while preserving the write path integrity critical during settlement peak. If rollback fails or latency persists, regional failover (memory_b2 pattern) remains available as secondary intervention. This preserves decision space while addressing the highest-confidence failure mode.
